properties.areaDesc: Lake Okeechobee
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 22 at 3:37PM EDT until August 22 at 4:15PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Lake Okeechobee...

At 336 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing waterspouts
were located along a line extending from 6 nm west of Buckhead Ridge
to near Calusa, moving northeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Boats could suffer significant structural
damage in high winds. Small craft could capsize in suddenly
higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Calusa, Liberty Point, Buckhead Ridge, Moore Haven, and Clewiston.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
Wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, small hail, high waves, dangerous
lightning, and heavy rain are possible with these storms.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 22 at 3:54PM EDT until August 22 at 5:30PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Okeechobee...

* Until 530 PM EDT.

* At 354 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near Buckhead
Ridge to Clewiston, moving northeast at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Boats could suffer significant structural
damage in high winds. Small craft could capsize in
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Buckhead Ridge, Pahokee, and Clewiston.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
Wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, small hail, high waves, dangerous
lightning, and heavy rain are possible with these storms.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.
